assets.caption: Two-part engineering drawing showing P-12 pressure connection details for welded piping. Bottom detail shows NPS 2 LINE SIZE & UP configuration with NPS 3/4 WELDOLET OR BUTT WELD PIPET PER SPECIFICATION, NPS 3/4 FLANGE VALVE, and NPS 3/4 RAISED FACE WELD NECK FLANGE.
